contributions.statement: Weight-level security editing of open code models fixes trained CWEs but does not transfer to unseen CWEs and can cost functional correctness.
contributions.evidence: §3.2 (29 scenarios, 17 unseen CWEs) and §3.3 Table 4 HumanEval Pass@k; 3B-8B open models only.

contributions.statement: Keep static analysis as the security gate rather than trusting a 'secure-tuned' model.
contributions.evidence: Implied by the generalization failure; not tested in an agent loop.

reason: The team consumes hosted models and cannot edit weights; the only transferable lesson is the known practice of keeping SAST as the gate.
